Toy multiSimmap of a binary trait: stochastic maps of the elevation

Source: R/dataset_doc.R
toy_multiSimmap_elevation.Rd

Set of 10 stochastic character maps (multiSimmap) of phylograftR::toy_backbone for the elevation of phylograftR::toy_tip_data ("high" and "low"), inferred like phylograftR::toy_multiSimmap (models "ER" and "ARD" compared with their AICc; the best model was the equal-rates model "ER"; seed 2345; 100 maps simulated, the first 10 kept).

It has the same number of maps as phylograftR::toy_multiSimmap, so that the two can be combined as the maps of two traits: the maps of the traits are paired (map 1 of each trait, then map 2 of each trait, and so on).

Usage

data(toy_multiSimmap_elevation)

Format

An object of classes "multiSimmap" and "multiPhylo": a list of 10 objects of class "simmap", with the same tips, topology and branch lengths as phylograftR::toy_backbone.

See also

Other datasets and functions from phylograftR:

  • phylograftR::toy_tip_data for the tip data used to build the maps.

  • phylograftR::toy_simmap_elevation for a single map of the same states.

  • phylograftR::toy_multiSimmap for the maps of the colors.

Examples

# Import the data
data(toy_multiSimmap)
data(toy_multiSimmap_elevation)

# Maps of two traits: a list with one element per trait,
# each a multiSimmap with the same number of maps
maps_two_traits <- list(color = toy_multiSimmap, elevation = toy_multiSimmap_elevation)
sapply(maps_two_traits, length)
#>     color elevation 
#>        10        10
